sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

Players control each stick figure using the WASD keys or arrow keys, depending on their preference. Each stick figure has unique abilities and weaponry, allowing players to choose the right character for the job. With a variety of special moves, combos, and power-ups, players must use their skills strategically to take down enemy stickmen and complete levels.

One of the key features of Stickman Team Return is its variety of playable characters. Each character has unique abilities and strengths, allowing players to choose the right character for the job. From the classic stickman with his trusty sword to the ninja with his stealthy abilities, each character brings something new to the table.

The game's combat system is fast-paced and addictive, with a focus on quick reflexes and strategic thinking. Players must use their skills to take down enemy stickmen, avoiding their attacks and exploiting their weaknesses.
